name: react-spring
description_en: ✌️ A spring physics based React animation library
readme_excerpt: react-spring A spring-physics first animation library giving you flexible tools to confidently cast your ideas react-spring is a cross-platform spring-physics first animation library. It's as simple as: Just a small bit about us: - Cross-Platform: We support react-dom and react-three-fiber. - Versatile: Be declarative with your animations or if you prefer, imperative. - Spring-Physics First: By default animation use springs for fluid interactivity, but we support durations with easings as well.…
